[EN] {@LinkCreature:230#3026#Lilis}, up at the {@Rgn:9017001$$Lighthouse of the Sun}, can't get around one of the golems inside.

Care to help out?
[ES] {@LinkCreature:230#3026#Lilis}, arriba en el {@Rgn:9017001$$Lighthouse of the Sun}, no puede pasar de uno de los golems que hay dentro.

¿Te importaría ayudar?

[EN] , the {@LinkCreature:417#2001#old keeper} near the top of the tower won't let me near the igniter, and it needs cleaning or it'll break down again.

Find it and shut it down.
[ES] , el {@LinkCreature:417#2001#old keeper} cerca de la cima de la torre no me deja acercarme al encendedor, y necesita una limpieza o volverá a fallar.

Encuéntralo y apágalo.

[EN] Thanks.

The tower's unstable enough when I can keep it clean!
[ES] Gracias.

¡La torre ya es bastante inestable incluso cuando puedo mantenerla limpia!
